fact: The Guidan Shawara web and mobile platform was launched officially in Niamey in September 2021, letting citizens file complaints and suggestions on public services that inspectors general route to the bodies concerned within 5 to 15 days, initially for education, health, agriculture, environment and internal security.
title: Lancement de la plateforme « Guidan Shawara » : Une interface digitale interactive pour une gouvernance participative et l'ancrage de la veille citoyenne
